questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

13 + 15 × 8 ÷ 96 − 4 = 109
questions.solution:
**BODMAS Rule:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4bb3744cda8a395214876e844107b09b0764aaffef5df41e4547dbbca9e72dfc.png] 

The two signs which should be interchanged to make the given equation correct is:

1. + and ÷

__**13 ÷ 15**__ × 8 + 96 − 4 = 109

⇒ __**0.86 **____**× 8**__ + 96 − 4 = 109

⇒ __**6.94 + 96** __− 4 = 109

⇒__ **102.94 - 4**__ = 109

⇒&nb

questions.question: Four letter-clusters have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the one that is different.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/71d0505d307612d6cf1dce5e97401a8ced54be79a5519712f21135f64c8fc7df.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**Logic:** First letter + 2 = Second Letter and Second and Third letters are coded according to the equivalent opposite letter of a particular letter of the word.

 
• QSH → Q + 2 = S; S ↔ H
 
• **MPI → M + 3 = P; P ↔ K ≠** I
 
• KMN → K + 2 = M; M ↔ N
 
• CEV → C + 2 = E; E ↔ V

Hence, '**MPI**' is the odd one out.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

questions.question: If 80% of a number is 768, what will be 40% of 5% of that number?
questions.solution:
Let the number be x.

If 80% of a number is 768.

80x/100 = 768

⇒ x = (768 × 100)/80

⇒ x = 960

40% of 5% of that number

40/100 × 5/100 × 960

= 192000/10000

= 19.2

Hence, '**19.2**' is the correct answer.
